title: PageSize
description: A 'Products per page' selector for a search surface. Its own componentType lets it be mounted through the A2-UI tree (one renderer per componentType). It owns the current pageSize in its state and dispatches setPageSize; the backend applies the change to the surface's paging so the pagination component re-renders from the shared view.

PageSizeState.title: PageSizeState
PageSizeState.description: The current page size. Owned exclusively by the backend. Kept as its own entry (keyed by this component's id) so the selector reads exactly the field it needs without depending on the pagination component's state shape.

pageSize.description: The number of items displayed per page.

SetPageSizeAction.title: setPageSize
SetPageSizeAction.description: Changes the number of items displayed per page.

pageSize.description: The number of items to display per page.
